intro: A 350 ml cup of latte has about 190 kcal (estimate). Most of it comes from full cream fresh milk, not the coffee.
diet: Yes. Latte is actually a fairly okay coffee choice. The milk gives some protein and helps you feel full. What pushes the calories up is flavoured syrup, whipped cream and large sizes. Stick to a regular size and skip the syrup, and a latte fits into your diet easily.
tips: Ask for low-fat or skim milk if they have it.
Skip the flavoured syrup, or ask for just half a pump.
Choose a small or medium size, not large.

swap.name: Low-fat milk latte, no sugar
swap.why: Tastes like a latte with almost the same protein, but much less fat and calories.

faq.q: What's the difference between a latte and a cappuccino?
faq.a: A latte has more milk and a little foam. A cappuccino has less milk and more foam, so it's usually lower in calories.

faq.q: How much caffeine is in a latte?
faq.a: It depends on the number of espresso shots. Most cafes use 1-2 shots for a regular size.

faq.q: Is oat milk healthier than normal milk?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Oat milk has about the same calories but less protein. Choose based on taste and needs, for example if you're lactose intolerant.
